what: On hover, four color strips sweep inside the dark button from the left, slanted (bottom at 120%), staggered .04s apart over 1.5s expo.inOut, and the last color stays. Letters pop in .02s stagger with weight +200, 1.4x size and ±8° (.6s circ.in), then return (.4s) as the text color changes. Both entering and leaving run 1.25x faster, and releasing reverses the wipe

options.dur: Duration used by each band (s), default 1.5
options.tilt: Random tilt range of letters (°), default 8
options.--fx-base · --fx-band-1~4: Background and four band colors (css variables). Default runs dark ink → three accent-family shades → accent
options.--fx-ink · --fx-ink-on · --fx-wght: Initial text color · text color after the band covers it · weight at rest (variable font)

from.where: shared.js setupButton — a Sign up button on each header row and section, a long band below pricing, review arrows (original Button.js: band 1.5s expo.inOut .04 stagger · timeScale 1.25 · letters --enter .6 circ.in / --leave .4 circ.in · weight 600±200)

note: The original overlays the same band on two layers, an arrow circle and a text pill, and swaps the arrow with MorphSVG. This part handles just one button layer. The text width is locked to its initial width so the line does not wobble when the weight changes.
